title: Converge maintenance decomposition with governance protections
description:
Problem: maintenance-agent architecture currently concentrates proposal workflow, scheduler, and governance-sensitive behavior in one large service file.

Desired outcome: decompose maintenance architecture while preserving approval workflows, proposal integrity, and admin governance boundaries.

Scope:
- In scope: split maintenance workflow/store/scheduler/topic-map concerns and enforce governance invariants from TSK-0048.
- Out of scope: changing proposal semantics or governance policy intent.

Acceptance criteria:
- Maintenance services are decomposed into coherent bounded components.
- Proposal approval/reject/respond and admin authorization behavior remains stable.
- Regression tests cover proposal lifecycle and governance-sensitive paths.

Validation:
- Run maintenance workflow tests and security/admin policy tests affected by refactor.

comments.author: AgentSmith
comments.body: Convergence task created to keep governance trust boundaries intact during maintenance architecture decomposition.
